source_row_ids: row_<zero-based original CSV row index>; TAID retained separately

grouping.identity_prerequisite: Graph/stereo-preserving model input identity; raw fields and provisional canonical hashes are not final proof.
grouping.union_rule: Connected components of verified identical model inputs, verified same constitutional/parent-family links, and scaffold or acyclic cluster links; all linked records stay together.
grouping.stereoisomers: May remain distinct input graphs but may not cross structure groups.
grouping.scaffold: Non-stereochemical Bemis-Murcko; preserve the complete molecular input; parent normalization only for grouping.
grouping.parent_family: Do not automatically largest-fragment strip salts/metals/mixtures. Simple spectator/uncharger candidate scan found zero distinct-input links; tautomer/complex mixture equivalence remains unproven. Any additional parent union requires a written chemical rule before fold allocation.
grouping.source_inchikey_or_missing_id: Never merge using a missing ID or an unverified source ID alone.
grouping.group_id: SHA256 of sorted unique verified identity members with unambiguous length-delimited serialization
grouping.large_group_policy: Never split the group to attain a nominal proportion. Report realized proportions; review resource or coverage failure before training.

deterministic_assignment.status: C01 operational default; implementation and actual coverage must be checked before C04 lock
deterministic_assignment.order: descending group record count, then ascending SHA256(seed || group_id)
deterministic_assignment.outer_destinations: fold IDs 0..K-1; all tasks share this assignment
objective_lexicographic: Sum over partition/task of max(0, minimum_required_groups - groups_with_any_observed_label).
Mean squared relative-to-total record allocation error plus mean squared relative-to-total task-positive-group allocation error against target fractions.
deterministic_assignment.greedy: For each ordered group, choose the destination minimizing the global objective after placement; exact tie -> lowest destination ID.
deterministic_assignment.bounded_repair: At most 20 deterministic passes over the same group order. Move one whole group only for strict lexicographic improvement; destination ties -> lowest ID. Stop on a no-improvement pass. Do not split groups or try alternate seeds.
deterministic_assignment.inner: For each outer fold use remaining groups, same ordered greedy/repair to train and validation at ratio 7:1. Group minimums are train=5, validation=2. Outer target minimum=2.
deterministic_assignment.interpretation: Failure means the registered algorithm did not meet coverage; not proof no mathematically feasible allocation exists.
deterministic_assignment.forbidden: No label magnitude, loss, model performance, error, or candidate-split performance search.

coverage.five_fold_failure: Run the same registered algorithm once with K=3; preserve both diagnostic reports.
coverage.three_fold_failure: Return to Codex with exact failing tasks/groups. No silent task removal or automatic relaxation.

target_block.nonhuman_pool: All 56 other tasks; the 12 sparse rows in target_block_candidates.tsv are diagnostics, not an exclusion list.
target_block.ranking: Ascending minimum number of independent full-training structure groups across all selected outer folds; task_name lexicographic tie-break.
target_block.unknown_species_or_route: Kept under their literal unknown category; not silently omitted from the 59 tasks or called a known species/route.
target_block.eligibility: Full-view coverage rules above; final names frozen at C04 without model results.

sparse_views.selection_unit: verified chemical identity; all linked records for the selected target are visible together
sparse_views.ranking: SHA256(length-delimited fold_id, task_name, subset_seed, verified chemical_id); identity tie-break
sparse_views.count: ceil(fraction * count of full-training labeled chemical identities for that target)
sparse_views.source_labels: All non-target labels remain exactly identical between fractions.
sparse_views.train_zero_action: stop this view; never skip task silently
sparse_views.scalers_counts_adjacency: Derived only after applying this exact visible training mask.
sparse_views.validation_and_test: Unchanged; disclose full validation label cost, no test-led choice.

endpoint_differences.difference_direction: first task minus second task on supplied transformed scale
endpoint_differences.eligibility_uses: label presence, verified chemical identity, same measurement and nominal scale; no difference magnitude
endpoint_differences.duplicates: Preserve source observations; establish any within-task aggregation rule before model fitting. Do not form Cartesian pseudo-replicates.

explanations.fixed_selection: Use all coverage-qualified candidates; if one fails explain eligibility and leave its slot empty. No replacement based on attractive maps.
explanations.final_panel_freeze: C06C; retain failures; no explanation image inspection for selection

mmp.atom_map_symmetry: Verified maps; use equivalence classes where ambiguous, never arbitrary numbering.

prerequisites_before_training: C02 graph/stereo-safe identities and explicit FeatureSpec
G01 actual cache and deterministic fold reports
